territorial_scope.description: Applies to Gansu Province: municipal and prefectural governments, Lanzhou New Area, provincial departments and central units in Gansu, concerning data centres in Gansu and the Qingyang cluster.

evidence.quote: 各市、自治州人民政府，甘肃矿区办事处，兰州新区管委会，省政府各部门，中央在甘各单位

summary.short: Gansu measures (Gan Zheng Ban Fa [2022] No. 103) supporting the Gansu hub of the national integrated computing network. Directs new large data centres in principle to the Qingyang cluster; provides land, electricity, energy-quota, tax, finance and talent support; requires monitoring; bans crypto mining in data centres. Dated 28 August 2022.
summary.long: Notice of the Gansu Provincial People's Government General Office (Gan Zheng Ban Fa [2022] No. 103), dated 28 August 2022 and published 20 September 2022, setting out measures to support construction and operation of the Gansu hub of the national integrated computing network. Part I covers factors: new large data centres are to be located in the Qingyang cluster in principle, and local governments may not grant land or tax preferences for data centres built outside it; older, small or inefficient facilities are to be retrofitted to electricity-use efficiency of 1.5 or below by 2025; land, electricity and energy-quota arrangements are set, including exemption from demand-charge fees for big-data firms until end-2025. Part II covers talent training and support. Part III covers funding, tax and finance: special-fund support, a 15% corporate income tax rate for qualifying Qingyang firms, a 50% reduction of listed local taxes for 2022-2024, and credit support. Part IV covers investment attraction, approval streamlining and a ban on discriminatory pricing by telecom operators. Part V covers regulation: a monitoring platform for data-centre energy use, a ban on crypto mining in data centres, responsibility commitments, and a two-year inclusive supervision period for new business types.

notes: Covers the full notice and attached measures (items 1–40). The signing date 2022年8月28日 and publication date 2022-09-20 are as stated in the document. The notice gives no effective date or expiry for the measures overall. Item 1 uses 原则上 (in principle) for siting rules, so they are not absolute. Item 28's tax reductions are dated 2022-01-01 to 2024-12-31. Item 9's power-fee exemption runs to end-2025. The text refers to central policy (党中央、国务院) without document identifiers; not coded. Entity lei and ticker fields are empty strings because none are verified. section_status entries are schema-required; entries are present in the arrays.

enforcement.note: The text states no sanction, fine, penalty, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension or blocking. Article 37 prohibits data centres from joining virtual-currency mining projects, and Article 39 requires commitments covering investment scale, construction schedule, technical standards, tax compliance and energy saving, but neither provision states a consequence for breach. Article 40 grants a two-year inclusion period for new business forms with 'administrative guidance' as the supervisory method, which is not a sanction.
